Singapore Seizes Luxury Condos in Money-Laundering Case, Buyers Scarce

Singaporean authorities have seized luxury condominiums as part of the city-state's largest money-laundering case. Despite the seizures, the properties are struggling to attract buyers, with one potential buyer expressing a desire to "just come and see." The case involves significant illicit funds, and the seized assets are now on the market.
